The '''Validus Glyph''' is an {{Epic}} Quest Item obtained in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Validus Glyph''' can be obtained by starting {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}'s quest and then opening the chest at {{Coords|-57.5|70|-95.5}} by the pond in the {{Zone|West Village}}. Once given to Okron, it can no longer be obtained.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Usage ==
The '''Validus Glyph''' can be given to {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}. When given, he will task the player with using the {{Item|Warding Diamathame}} to imbue a spell onto the house.
